posts.community: Platinum Industries : India’s third-largest manufacturer of PVC stabilisers
posts.text: Investment Rationale : Platinum Industries Limited presents a classic capacity-ahead-of-earnings setup. The company is I ndia’s third-largest manufacturer of PVC stabilisers (the additives that make plastic pipes, wires and window frames possible), with a ~13% market share , the only listed pure-play in the category, and a domestic near-monopoly in the higher-value CPVC additives. Over the last two years, it has commissioned two capacity expansions that roughly double installed capacity: a new ₹71 crore plant at Palghar and a ₹67 crore greenfield plant in Egypt.
